 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Athletic Club, unbeaten at San Mamés in the league this season, host a Getafe side in turmoil following Bordalás's inflammatory comments and a clear crisis on the pitch.
 Here are the lineups for today's match at La Catedral:
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Athletic : Unai; Yuri, Paredes, Vivian, Rincón; Canales, Galarreta, Nico Williams, Berenguer, Iñaki Williams and Maroan.
 The suspended Laporte is absent, but both Williams brothers are on the pitch. Canales comes into midfield, Rincón slots in at right-back and Maroan leads the attack.
 Getafe : Soria; Mojica, Valou, Gudelj, Carvajal, Terrats, Francho, Mario, Kiko Femenía, Satriano and Iván Azón.
 Even Enes Unal misses out on a starting spot this time.
